ruleDefinitions.name: Creation Of a Suspicious ADS File Outside a Browser Download
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a suspicious ADS (Alternate Data Stream) file by software other than browsers Note: Unmapped fields: Contents

sequences.query: (Contents = RGX("^\\[ZoneTransfer\\]\\ \\ ZoneId\\=3") AND file_path = RGX("\\:Zone\\\.Identifier$") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.exe.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.scr.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.docx.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.hta.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.jse.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.lnk.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.pptx.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ps.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.reg.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.sct.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vb.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.wsc.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.wsf.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx.*"))) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome\.exe") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox\.exe") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeWebView\\\\Application\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsApps\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\safari\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\TempState\\\\Screenshot\\ .*")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\.png\\:Zone\\\.Identifier$")))
